name: Beaconing — fixed-interval outbound connections
kql: DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemotePort != 443 or Direction == 'Outbound' | summarize start=min(Timestamp), end=max(Timestamp), total=count(), distinct=make_set(RemoteUrl) by InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP | extend span = datetime_diff('second', end, start) | where total >= 10 | extend rate = total / max(span / 3600.0, 1) | where rate >= 0.5 and rate <= 30
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational EventCode=3 Direction=Out | stats count by Image, DestIp, _time | where count > 10
tuning: Baseline legit cloud telemetry; look for count spikes from single process at regular delta (jitter-aware)
